cards.review_notes: Only a general mention of summer camps is verified. Confirm the program name, day-camp format and all operational details directly with the provider. The homepage publishes the stable address as 165 Tommy Campbell Road, Jonesborough, TN, but does not explicitly identify it as the camp drop-off site. It also says access is from Highway 81 because Tommy Campbell Road is closed on the Cherokee Road side.
